scope: Independent review of the Base scaling v2 and generated-business correction diffs; exact reviewed bytes below. The coordinator did not author these four file changes.
findings_closed: Base native table-get prerequisites now return table metadata, fields and views in the shapes consumed by the frozen CLI. Known unmodeled view-property reads remain explicitly unsupported; foreign and invalid reads remain rejected.

Base report validation checks the task-required integer created count, exact unique record IDs and required path. Optional report metadata no longer imposes an unstated native schema. Independent full typed rows, sentinel/schema/input preservation and signed mutation effects remain mandatory.

Business final-form verification compares unambiguous decoded JSON with scalar types and array order preserved; whitespace, object-key ordering and Unicode escaping can vary. Duplicate keys, nonfinite values, altered values and types fail. The write and idempotency rules are unchanged.

Approval initiated reads accept the documented definition filter and reflect pre/post-creation state. Native list fields and numeric-string status enums replace invented fields; the deterministic pagination expectation correction is separate from unchanged representative model prompts.
limitations: Native process checks were executed by the owners and inspected here, not independently rerun. Their reports explicitly retain the unrecorded official binary hash limitation.
This approves only the listed fixture corrections, not shared verifier diagnostics, Sheets changes, historical model-outcome rescoring, or a new comparative result.
Historical failed and unknown trial costs must remain separate. New trials require a frozen evaluator condition; product and guidance remain frozen.
No live behavior, full functional parity, token improvement or release acceptance is established by this review.
